props.title: Event Photography and Video in Denver | Signet Artists
props.description: Add a photographer or videographer to your live music booking in Denver and across Colorado, with one point of contact and one contract.

service.name: Event photography and video
service.serviceType: Event photography and highlight video, booked alongside live music
service.description: A photographer or videographer added to a live music booking for corporate events, private parties and wedding cocktail hours in Denver and across Colorado, on the same contract as the music.

props.title: Event photos and video, booked with your music.
props.lede: Add a photographer or videographer to your Signet booking, and you'll have your event in photos and a short video to keep.

rows.text: Edited photos of your guests, your speakers and the music.
A short recap of your event, plus clips sized for social media.

props.title: Why add photos and video through Signet

rows.text: The same person looks after your music and your photos and video.
Your photographer works from the same plan as the band, so they know where the music is set up and which moments matter most to you.
Photos and video go on the same contract as your music, so there's no second vendor to find, vet and manage.

props.html: We can add photos and video to an office holiday party, a client dinner, a gala or fundraiser, a company retreat, a milestone birthday or a wedding cocktail hour.

items.q: Can I add photos or video after I've booked the music?
items.a: Yes. Just let us know, and we'll check the date and add it to your booking.

items.q: When will we get the photos and video?
items.a: Usually within a week of the event (depending on the project).

items.q: Can you photograph our whole wedding day?
items.a: For full wedding-day photography or film, take a look at the photographers and videographers on our Preferred Vendor List.

props.title: Tell us about your event.
props.lede: Choose photos or video when you check a date, or just mention it in your message, and we'll include it in your quote.
